# shooosh

> WGSL-first site GPU engine. WebGPU when available, WebGL2 fallback. Documentation and tasks are written for coding agents.

**No magic.** The package is composition primitives + shader contracts. Looks (bloom, FXAA, grain, PBR, fluids) live as copyable WGSL/GLSL in `examples/`. Do not ingest `node_modules/` or `dist/`.

## Start here

| Goal | Read |
| --- | --- |
| **Ship a look** | This file → [examples/README.md](./examples/README.md) → [agent copy guide](./examples/agent-guide.md) → copy the selected demo and helpers |
| **Change the engine** | This file → [agents.md](./agents.md) → next [docs/agent-tasks/](./docs/agent-tasks/) with `status: todo` |
| **Mount on a site** | Skill [shooosh-site](./.cursor/skills/shooosh-site/SKILL.md) → [docs/site-patterns.md](./docs/site-patterns.md) if needed |

Humans on GitHub: [readme.md](./readme.md) → [docs/README.md](./docs/README.md) → [docs/getting-started.md](./docs/getting-started.md).

## When to use shooosh

- Fullscreen shader, page-behind layer, or DOM-tracked quads
- Authored language is WGSL; same code on WebGPU or WebGL2
- Agents compose primitives — they do not invent a scene API or named effect presets

## Public API (composition)

Source in a checkout: [`package/index.ts`](./package/index.ts),
[`package/dom/index.ts`](./package/dom/index.ts), and
[`package/utility/index.ts`](./package/utility/index.ts). An npm installation ships
declarations and runtime builds; examples and skills require the source checkout.
Use source matching your installed version; unreleased recipes can require new APIs.

- `probeRenderer()` → `"webgpu" | "webgl2" | null`
- `createEngine` / `initEngine` / `getDefaultEngine` — `{ backend?: "auto"|"webgpu"|"webgl2" }`
- `createCanvasScene` — lightweight owned canvas + `retain(resource)` cleanup; full `createScene` retains convenience features. See [bundle setups](./docs/bundle-setup.md).
- `createScene` / `parseSceneDataset`
- `acquireLayer` / `releaseLayer`
- `shooosh/dom`: `createDomLayer({ canvas, root })` → cached `bind` / `media`, native fallback, explicit cleanup. See [docs/dom.md](./docs/dom.md) for the supported subset.
- `createItem` / `createScreen` / `createObject` / `createParticles` / `createMsdfGlyphs`
- `createPostProcessor().addFragmentEffect({ fragmentShader, fragmentShaderWgsl })` — no named bloom/bw/noise; copy [`examples/post-shaders.ts`](./examples/post-shaders.ts)
- `effects.custom` — thin sugar for `createScene({ post })` (author shaders only)
- `createCompute` — WebGPU; fluids = copy `examples/fluid-sim.ts` + `fluid-shaders.ts`
- `loadTexture` (+ `fitUv` / `textureFit` / `{ flipY: false }` for env) / `loadGlb`
- `shooosh/webgl2` / `shooosh/webgpu` and matching `/dom`: backend-only builds; default root remains both.
- `shooosh/build`: build-time `.wgsl` plugin / CLI — [shader pipeline](./docs/shader-build.md)
- `shooosh/compiler`: optional `compileShader`, `convertWgslFragmentToGlsl` / `convertGlslFragmentToWgsl` (removed from root)
- `createMouseMonad` / `createMouseTrail`
- `shooosh/utility`: `createSpinner({ element })` → drag rotation + release inertia; see [docs/utility.md](./docs/utility.md).

Node/Bun only (`shooosh/msdf`): `generateMsdf` / `generateFontAtlas` / `generateIconSdf` / `alphaToSdf` · CLI `pnpm msdf`

- `shooosh/utils`: optional quaternion composition, vector rotation and pose mapping; see [docs/utils.md](./docs/utils.md). No renderer imports.

## Shader contract (short)

See [docs/shader-contract.md](./docs/shader-contract.md).

- Author `fn fsMain() -> vec4f`. `vUv` is top-origin. WebGL2 requires a generated `fragmentGlsl` alongside WGSL; the browser runtime does not translate.
- Textures: sample `fitUv(vUv)` when using `uTexture` + cover/contain.
- `setUni({ value1 })` → `uUni.values0.x` / `uUni[0].x` (16 floats).
- Post is `applyEffect`, not `fsMain` — both GLSL + WGSL for dual backends.
- Failed compile keeps the last good program; never blank the page.
